notes: Single API key (via Authorization: Token header or apikey query param) authenticates both the Data API and Project API; no free/trial tier documented, requires an active paid subscription (Essential+). Vendor also publishes an official open-source MCP server (MIT license, hosted at api.seranking.com/mcp) exposing 160+ tools, connectable via OAuth for clients like Claude Desktop/Code — but the underlying account still needs a paid plan since MCP calls draw on the same API credits.
